title: Quantifying social organization and political polarization in online platforms
reasoning: The paper analyzes social dimensions like political partisanship, age, and gender on Reddit. While it identifies some religiously-affiliated communities (e.g., r/TrueChristian) as data points to place them on a political spectrum, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, ethical frameworks, or moral reasoning. The focus is on social organization and polarization, not faith or ethics as a primary subject of study.
